notes: All seven pages are fragments of the unsigned women's column 'Per le nostre Signore' (Moda, Per la bellezza delle labbra, Note di estetica, Il Portamento, Seguendo la moda, etc.); no byline or signature appears on any page. The partial neighbouring columns at the right edge are cut off and illegible; one on p. 5 ('Come e perché sorse la Società di M. S. C...') is visible only as a heading and its signature, if any, is not on the page.
